headline: Catchers: it's more than pop time.
caption:
Is your player a catcher? Pop time gets a lot of attention, but it's only one piece of what college coaches look for.

Coaches also evaluate:
⚾ Receiving: does he give his pitchers quiet, steady strikes?
⚾ Blocking: can they trust him with a breaking ball in the dirt?
⚾ Throwing: quick feet, quick release and an accurate throw
⚾ Leadership: does he run the game and handle his pitchers?

A strong arm opens the door. The rest of the job is what keeps him on the field.

When you film his video, show all four, not just throws to second.

See how your player's profile compares across D1, D2, D3, NAIA and JUCO:
https://baseballfuture.com
